scope: Primary-source method review for a distinct data-only R1 continuation; not a new executed recipe

sources.observations: The official trainer obtains target indices with a separate frozen HQ VQGAN and supervises encoder features against quantized codebook features; it has image/perceptual/adversarial options. Our R1 uses its declared original inpainting-encoder prequantized latent teacher and no GAN/perceptual objectives. These are not exact reproductions.

The source synthesizes brush-stroke inpainting masks, distinguishes corruption from the inpainting branch, and applies its optional gray conversion to the input. Our appearance-preserving grayscale augmentation must transform both input and known target; do not copy an input-only colorization objective.

The published configuration declares a 1024-entry codebook. Our admitted released inpainting checkpoint and official inference script use512. Preserve the actual512 architecture and checkpoint instead of copying an incompatible configuration.

The released inpainting inference code constructs a512-entry CodeFormer, uses cropped aligned512 input and fixes fidelity weight1/adainFalse. Our wrapper additionally resizes prepared256 visible support and copies observed pixels exactly.

The training document separates VQGAN prior learning, code-sequence prediction and controllable-module training. It does not qualify our finite thesis adaptation or provide evidence for real-Zamboanga performance.

decision: Preserve trained R1 and the declared current teacher/loss/LR for a first isolated data-coverage experiment. Retain the quantized-teacher alternative as a separate future audit/ablation, not a silent extra variable.
